item.tib: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus dbu ma chen po bla med yongs rtse
item.coloph: ces pas dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus dbu ma chen po bla med yongs brtse (rtse) zhes bya ba 'di ni/ drin chen dam pa nang so g.yung drung bstan 'dzin khu dbon dang*/ snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal yon o dri sangs rgyas gling pa pad ma g.yung drung dpal bo gsas kyi zhal lung byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang skyes chen dam pa mang po'i gsung gi (gsung gis) bskul ba la brten nas/ g.yung drung gi bstan pa la mi dman tsam du mchis pas (pa'i/)rig 'dzin g.yung drung gling pa stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor can gyis/ yongs 'dzin gyis (gyi) lo chu bstod (stod) zla ba'i dkar phyogs su/ gnas chen lha mo dngul kha ljongs kyi byang phyogs/ drung mu gyer gyi gdan sa chen po rang gsal 'od kyi pho brang du sug bris bgyis shing / yi ge pa ni sa dra'i ming gi (gis) byas pa 'dis kyang / sngags sems kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs brgyar yongs su dar nas/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud yongs su grol te thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid du gyur cig/
